Lasso or elastic net selection via glmnet

select_glmnet.Rd

A wrapper for glmnet::cv.glmnet() (or glmnet::glmnet() at a fixed lambda). Cross-validation is random, so set a seed for reproducibility. Predictors are standardized first; see tidy.selector().

Usage

select_glmnet(
  formula,
  data,
  family = c("gaussian", "binomial", "poisson"),
  lambda = c("best", "compact"),
  fitted_selector = NULL,
  alpha = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

a model formula, as for lm(). It may include interactions (x * z) and in-formula transformations (log(x), poly(x, 2)); factor, logical and character predictors are treatment-coded. Ordered factors and missing values are not supported. See tidy.selector() for how the columns are standardized and named.

data

a data frame

family

outcome distributional family

lambda

"best" (default) or "compact", both chosen by cross-validation (see Details), or a single number giving a fixed penalty.

fitted_selector

a previously fit selector, used by reselect()

alpha

the elastic net mixing parameter, passed to glmnet: 1 (default) is the lasso

...

additional arguments passed to glmnet::cv.glmnet() or glmnet::glmnet(), e.g. nfolds, penalty.factor

Value

a selector wrapping the cv.glmnet (or glmnet) fit; see tidy.selector(). Its default inference method is infer_selective().

Details

With lambda = "best" the penalty is lambda.min, the value minimizing cross-validated error; with "compact" it is lambda.1se, the largest value whose cross-validated error is within one standard error of the minimum, which gives a sparser model.

Only the lasso (alpha = 1) is supported by infer_selective().
